description.en: Hold the knife, push, blow the dust away

howToPlay.zh: 照着篆刻师傅的工序刻一方四字朱文印（字是凸的，用的是《说文解字》里的小篆）：先倒边，再刻边框、刻十字分成四格，然后一格一格刻字，最后吹去石粉。刻刀分两个区域：按住白色刀柄拖动是移刀，按住朱红色握把往上推就是刻。刀和视频里一样只往前推（屏幕上方），往回拉只会顺着刻过的槽退回；刀尖前的小点就是落刀点。要刻横线，就在刀以外的地方（印面或垫子上）绕着印石划，把印石转过来：印石可以停在任意角度，每 15° 轻轻吸一下，90° 吸得更牢，所以斜线（撇、捺）也能转过来刻。落刀点靠近稿线时会吸到线上，稿线变黄就是对准了（设置里可以关掉「对线辅助」）。刻字时镜头推近到当前这一格：红色的是要铲掉的空地，顺着红线一刀一刀往上推，笔画之间大多只有一刀宽，宽一点的地方多推几刀；笔画永远刻不坏。红线都刻完、或空地铲得差不多了，剩下的自动收尾，转到下一个字。刻偏了点刀尖旁的 ↶ 撤销最后一划；右上角「试印」随时盖一下看看现在的效果，「重刻」可以只重刻当前这一步，或者整方从头再来。最后点印面上的「吹」吹净石粉，印蜕收进「印谱」并解锁下一方。印面上刻的是反字，盖出来才是正的。电脑上同理用鼠标。键盘：方向键移刀，按住空格下刀、同时按上方向键往前推，Q 和 E 转动印石，Z 撤销，B 吹粉，A 打开印谱。
howToPlay.en: Carve a four-character seal with raised characters (朱文, in the small seal script of the Shuowen Jiezi), the way a seal carver does: chamfer the face's edges, cut the border and a cross into four cells, carve the characters, clear the ground, blow the powder away. The knife has two zones: drag the white handle to move it, hold the cinnabar grip and push up to carve. As in the video it only pushes forward (up the screen); drawing back slides it down its own groove. The dot ahead of its point is where it will cut. For a line across, draw an arc around the stone anywhere off the knife to turn it; it stays at any angle, settling lightly every 15° and firmly at each quarter, so slanted strokes can be carved too. Near a draft line the point settles onto it, and the line turns yellow (Line assist can be switched off in Settings). For the characters the camera closes in on one cell: the red is ground to cut away, a push up each red line; most gaps between strokes are a single groove, wider ones take a few pushes, and the strokes are never cut. Once the red lines are cut, or most of the ground is gone, the rest of the cell is cleared and the next character comes up. ↶ beside the point undoes the last swipe; Proof (top right) stamps the seal as it is to show the carving so far; Redo starts the current step, or the whole seal, over. Tap Blow on the face at the end: the print goes into Seals and the next seal opens. The face is carved mirrored so that it prints the right way round. A mouse works the same way. Keyboard: arrow keys move the knife; hold Space and Up to push; Q and E turn the stone, Z undoes, B blows, A opens your seals.
